about: state-upper contests of 2023 in Louisiana, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/la_sos.py's cache (the state's own official results; MEDSL holds no 2023).

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

la_sos.name: Louisiana Secretary of State, official election results (the results site's workbook of each date)
la_sos.licence: no licence printed; the Louisiana Secretary of State's official election returns, public records
la_sos.note: each date marked official on the site's list of elections ('ResultsOfficial': '1'); files read by pipeline/intake/la_sos.py: 2023-01-14 (Election+Results+(01-14-2023).xlsx, sha256 70985090259f, 1 contests); 2023-02-18 (Election+Results+(02-18-2023).xlsx, sha256 8572e624f9c2, 1 contests); 2023-03-25 (Election+Results+(03-25-2023).xlsx, sha256 d409466701a3, 62 contests); 2023-04-29 (Election+Results+(04-29-2023).xlsx, sha256 cab8b8ac64fe, 82 contests); 2023-10-14 (Election+Results+(10-14-2023).xlsx, sha256 b6bb14ddf813, 628 contests); 2023-11-18 (Election+Results+(11-18-2023).xlsx, sha256 748593399b07, 248 contests); 2023-12-16 (Election+Results+(12-16-2023).xlsx, sha256 67f65b59c481, 2 contests); gated within the certifying source against the site's own posted results of the contests on more than one parish's ballot (2023-02-18: https://voterportal.sos.la.gov/ElectionResults/ElectionResults/Data?blob=20230218/Votes_Multiparish.htm, read 2026-11-07T11:46Z, 2023-03-25: https://voterportal.sos.la.gov/ElectionResults/ElectionResults/Data?blob=20230325/Votes_Multiparish.htm, read 2026-11-07T11:46Z, 2023-04-29: https://voterportal.sos.la.gov/ElectionResults/ElectionResults/Data?blob=20230429/Votes_Multiparish.htm, read 2026-11-07T11:46Z, 2023-10-14: https://voterportal.sos.la.gov/ElectionResults/ElectionResults/Data?blob=20231014/Votes_Multiparish.htm, read 2026-11-07T11:34Z, 2023-11-18: https://voterportal.sos.la.gov/ElectionResults/ElectionResults/Data?blob=20231118/Votes_Multiparish.htm, read 2026-11-07T11:46Z)

fips.name: parish FIPS codes: the county_name and county_fips columns of MEDSL's 2024 Louisiana precinct file
